request_body.query:
query get {
  fulfillments(order_by: {created_at: desc}) {
    id
    name
    display_name
    thumbnail_logo
    large_logo
    description
    detail_url
    badge_text
    badge_color
    position
    active
    exportable
    large_logo
    created_at
    updated_at
    user_fulfillments {
      id
      api_key
      api_secret
      forwarding_shipping_method
      config
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

use_teeinblue_publisher_config.description: Publish campaigns to Shopify using the Teeinblue publisher configuration instead of the store defaults.

keep_shopify_inventory_config.description: Keep the existing Shopify inventory settings when (re)publishing product variants instead of overwriting them.

variant_taxable.description: Force the taxable flag on published Shopify variants. Null keeps the platform behavior.

sync_compare_at_price.description: Sync the variant compare-at price to Shopify when publishing campaigns.

product_template_auto_assign_enabled.description: Automatically assign the theme product template (see product_template_suffix) to products published to Shopify.

product_template_suffix.description: Shopify theme template suffix assigned to published products when product_template_auto_assign_enabled is on.

available_product_label.description: Custom label for the product option (e.g. "Style") on published listings. Null falls back to the campaign/product base label.

color_label.description: Custom label for the color option on published listings.

size_label.description: Custom label for the size option on published listings.

assign_first_variant_to_first_mockup.description: Assign only the first variant to the first mockup image when publishing.

assign_all_variants_to_first_mockup.description: Assign all variants to the first mockup image when publishing.

add_design_links.description: Where generated design links are written on the Shopify order: line item property, order note, or both.

mail_content.description: Etsy personalization email template content: email subjects (first/reminder), heading, description, footer, personalize button, colors, auto_resend_mail, resend_time, receive_personalization_email...

sender_name.description: Sender name on Etsy personalization emails. Null falls back to the instance name.

etsy_btn_mail_color.description: CTA button color in the Etsy personalization email. Null falls back to #F1641E (Etsy orange).

etsy_logo_url.description: Logo URL shown in the Etsy personalization email. Null falls back to the Teeinblue logo (portal/tib.png).

autofixer_disable.description: Storefront text auto-fixer is enabled unless this key is explicitly set to false (note: inverted naming — false disables it).

autofixer_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before the storefront text auto-fixer runs.

blacklisted_words.description: Array of words blocked in personalization text inputs (text, paragraph, spiral, scrabble, word-search layers).

confirmation_checkbox_enable_for_no_cust.description: Also require the confirmation checkbox for products without customization.

show_cross_sell.description: Enable the cross-sell block on the storefront personalizer.

cross_sell_display_on.description: Where the cross-sell block is displayed on the storefront.

customization_expiry_period.description: Expiry period for saved storefront customizations. Null uses the platform default.

form_display_type.description: Display type of the personalization form in the button-popup flow.

has_custom_upload_endpoint.description: Merchant uses a custom photo upload endpoint (see photo_endpoint).

photo_endpoint.description: Custom photo upload endpoint used by the storefront SDK instead of the default one.

image_placement_show_photo_switcher.description: Show the photo switcher in the image placement flow on the storefront.

is_display_customization_link.description: Display the customization link on the storefront cart/order flow.

is_display_customization_edit_link.description: Display the customization edit link on the storefront cart/order flow.

multiple_file_types.description: Allow multiple file types in the storefront vector upload field.

show_preview_button.description: Show the preview button on cart items rendered by the storefront SDK.

show_edit_button.description: Show the edit button on cart items rendered by the storefront SDK.

show_edit_greeting_card_button.description: Show the edit greeting card button on cart items rendered by the storefront SDK.

addon_charge_stock_to_sell.description: Stock-to-sell quantity applied to add-on charge products created by the storefront SDK.

maps_place_key.description: API key for the map place/geocoding provider used by map personalization layers.

maps_place_provider.description: Place/geocoding provider for map personalization layers (e.g. google).

maps_search_ignore_viewport.description: Ignore the map viewport when searching places in map personalization layers.

sync_design_to_platform.description: Sync generated designs back to the sales platform (Shopify etc.). Set false to disable design sync for the store.

sync_campaign_info_to_shopify.description: Sync campaign title/description updates to the published Shopify product.

sync_artwork_name_to_metafield.description: Write the artwork/template name into a Shopify product metafield when publishing.

clipart_max_per_category.description: Maximum cliparts allowed per category for this merchant. Null uses the platform limit (portal default: 300).

clipart_warning_threshold.description: Clipart count per category at which the portal shows a warning before the hard limit. Null falls back to 250.

delay_mass_update_campaigns.description: Delay in milliseconds between requests when mass-updating campaigns from the portal. Null falls back to 1000ms.

default_children_display_type.description: Default display type for child elements in the personalizer.

allow_small_image_upload.description: Skip the minimum-resolution check when customers upload photos.

is_bigger_gen_ai_large_size.description: Use a larger output size for generative AI image results.

background_remover_name.description: Background removal provider for this merchant (e.g. remove.bg, removal.ai, cutout.pro, teeinblue). Null uses the platform default. Provider-specific keys follow the {provider}_api_key pattern.

remove_bg_master_only.description: Only run remove.bg on the master image instead of every personalization render.

cutout_pro_master_only.description: Only run cutout.pro on the master image instead of every personalization render.

cutout_pro_photo_enhancer_display.description: Show the cutout.pro photo enhancer option to this merchant.

custom_threshold_face_cutout.description: Custom face-cutout pixel threshold in percent (divided by 100 at runtime). Null uses config app.face_cutout_pixel_threshold_ratio.

image_generation_name.description: AI image generation provider for this merchant. Provider-specific keys follow the {provider}_api_key / {provider}_model patterns.

flux_version.description: Flux Kontext model version used for AI design rendering.

gpt_quality.description: Image quality parameter passed to GPT image generation.

photo_upload_rate_limit.description: Customer photo uploads allowed per hour per client. Null uses env UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT (5).

is_allow_zero_price.description: Allow publishing campaign variants with a zero price.

product_type_same_as_product_base.description: Use the product base title as the Shopify product type when publishing.

canva_expires_at.description: System-managed: Canva access token expiry timestamp.

canva_connected_at.description: System-managed: timestamp when the merchant connected Canva.

default_template_settings_value.description: Default template_settings values auto-filled in the portal Artwork Editor for keys the artwork has not set explicitly, e.g. {"show_in_cart": true}.

show_addon_variant_rate.description: Show the rate input for add-on variants in the portal variant picker.
